title: Lose 50%? You Need 100% to Get Back #shorts
description:
Lose half your money and you need to double what's left just to get back to even. The comeback is always bigger than the drop: lose 10%, you need +11%; lose 50%, you need +100%; lose 80%, you need +400%. Nvidia closed at $239.24 on Oct 6, 2026 and $149.30 on Nov 25, a 37.6% fall, so it needs to rise 60.2% to get back to its October high.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: Nvidia (NVDA) daily closes from Yahoo Finance. The other numbers are simple percentage math: a loss of L% needs a gain of L / (100 - L).

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
